title: Old Town Museum

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: Old Town Museum offers the perfect combination of rustic charm and modern amenities for weddings, graduations, business meetings, conferences, and other private parties. With accommodation for up to 300 people, the Barn is the focal point of Old Town. The 100 yr old space is air conditioned and heated, offers on-site restrooms, a dedicated entrance, ample parking for guests, and a newly constructed bar area. The gazebo area is the perfect spot to make your outdoor wedding dreams come true. Gazebo and courtyard can seat in excess of 300 people. The 1921 church is ideal for a small, intimate wedding ceremonies or church services. The church is equipped with heat and seats 100-120 in church

blurb: Nestled in the heart of Colorado’s Central Plains. The 6 1/2 acre historic site includes 21 fully restored buildings with authentic artifacts from the turn-of-the-century. Easily accessible from I-70 near the Colorado / Kansas border, Old Town Museum celebrates local agriculture, history, and heritage.
